description: Four-engined de Havilland Heron in the open-air display line of the Iraqi Military Aviation Museum in the Al-Zawra quarter of Karkh, beside the Monument to the Unknown Soldier. Spottingmode records it as Iraqi Air Force 393 construction number 14105 but explicitly flags the identity as not sure, so no tail number is asserted here. A straight-wing four-engined type is visible at the display line on Esri imagery of 30 April 2025.

Early-model Iraqi Air Force MiG-21F-13 recorded as preserved at the Iraqi Military Aviation Museum in Baghdad. Delta-wing airframes are clearly visible in the museum's display line on Esri imagery of 30 April 2025, and OpenStreetMap carries six separate historic aircraft nodes there mapped on 13 May 2024, so the museum holds at least six airframes of which only this one and the Heron can be named.
